name: process-supervision
author: qiyang-tan
description: Supervise a two-robot Dora process cell through named atomic tools

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Get sanitized robot positions, switch states, safe limits, and process phase. Hidden temperature and pressure truth are never returned.

tools.name: navigate_robot
tools.description: Move the observer or operator robot to its named home or station through Dora. No coordinates are accepted.

tools.name: read_pressure
tools.description: Acquire a direct pressure reading through Dora. The observer must be docked at its station.

tools.name: read_temperature
tools.description: Request a fresh observer RGB frame and invoke the local multimodal model to return structured temperature JSON.

tools.name: apply_switch_actions
tools.description: Apply one or two immediate Octos-authored valve state changes through the operator robot. A stable action ID makes retries idempotent; future shutdowns require a later observation and a new action.

action_id.description: Stable ID supplied by the Supervisor. Reusing it returns the original receipt without repeating robot actions.

tools.name: report_activity
tools.description: Display a short current-agent action in the Webots process view for observability.

tools.name: wait_seconds
tools.description: Wait for an agent-selected observation interval while Dora continues high-frequency streaming and safety supervision.
